summary: Enhance your skills with Project Cycle Management training designed for development professionals. Learn effective strategies for successful project delivery.
lede: Project Cycle Management for Development Professionals provides a practical way to guide projects from initial concept through design, implementation, evaluation, and closeout. You will learn to ground projects in real problems and evidence while aligning plans with stakeholder needs, available resources, and expected results. The course covers problem and stakeholder analysis, logical frameworks, activity and budget planning, risk management, progress monitoring, and capturing lessons for future programming. It helps you apply structured, tool-based methods to proposals, projects, and portfolios while meeting donor requirements and strengthening institutional credibility.
audienceIntro: This course is crafted for professionals who are involved in planning, implementing, monitoring, and reporting on development projects, ensuring they are designed to address real-world challenges effectively.
audience: Program and project managers in NGOs
modules: Designing Projects with the Logical Framework Approach
Planning Activities, Work Plans, and Timelines
Integrating Budgeting and Resources into the Project Cycle
Risk Management, Assumptions, and Adaptive Planning
Implementing and Coordinating Projects Across Teams
Monitoring, Evaluation, and Learning within the Project Cycle
Project Closure, Sustainability, and Lessons Learned
prerequisites: Participants are expected to have a basic understanding of project management principles and some experience in managing or supporting development or humanitarian projects. Familiarity with development concepts and donor-funded project environments is recommended.
